propositions: A single Gerrit Verified run needs 21 concurrent slots but the org caps at 20 total / 5 macOS, causing runs to queue and inflate a ~21m run to 41-47m.
The 5 per-extra matrix cells plus a union cell each hold a full slot for only 0.4-0.8m of real work, so they are collapsed into one venv-loop job.
The isolation iteration set must equal _optional.EXTRAS keys plus mcp, giving metrics per-extra CI it lacked before.
A union iteration must install .[agents,eval,tracing] jointly to exercise joint dependency resolution that single-extra installs cannot surface.
The loop must never source activate and must invoke interpreters/console-scripts by absolute venv path to avoid stacked activations and ambient-interpreter false passes.
The loop must use an rc accumulator with continue and exit $rc so per-iteration failures aggregate instead of dying on first failure or always passing.
